snippet_primary: "This is one of the clearest wins in the comparison. Payhip has built-in EU VAT and UK VAT handling for digital products. It collects and remits VAT automatically, and provides tax reporting to keep you compliant. For EU or UK-based creators selling digital goods, this removes a significant administrative burden."

local_qualifiers: For EU or UK-based creators selling digital goods
